question: Of the people who open a subscription paywall, how many select a tier and how many finish or abandon checkout, by surface, tier, and billing interval, per namespace and build? Paywall Opened carries source and current_plan. Upgrade Plan Selected carries plan (tier id), billing_interval, and source. Upgrade Succeeded Attributed carries plan and billing_interval. Subscription Plan Changed carries previous_plan, new_plan, billing_interval, and change_source and is emitted from mobile checkout only. The cancel-flow events carry the closed reason enum. Upgrade Succeeded and Upgrade Cancelled stay property-less presence events: the registry forbids adding properties to those released ids, so a completed checkout emits Upgrade Succeeded Attributed in the same call. macos_settings_view and windows_settings_view are plan-grid impressions on the settings page, not a blocked purchase gate. Web Checkout opens in a new tab and does not return a cancel URL to this page, so web does not emit Upgrade Cancelled. Upgrade Modal Clicked and Upgrade Modal Dismissed are the app-version update prompt and are not in this funnel. ARPMAU's numerator is the BigQuery plan_revenue_daily snapshot, not these events and not a sum of webhook events.
zero_policy: Zero events is expected on builds that predate this registration, and on desktop or web until those clients ship the same wire names. A missing Paywall Opened row for one source means that surface did not open the plans sheet in the selected namespace and build.
